title: xdrip plus is not showing IoB in all cases
body:
### Your environment
Samsung S22
20221116-344deb4.apk
G6 for CGM data
MDI (so manual addition of bolus)

### Expected behavior
Under the xDrip+ text on the main screen there is an IoB: #.## field in usual operation

### Actual behavior
The above field appears at first load and then disappears sometime later. 
The only way to get the field back is to restart the phone.
